title: Signal: Dynamic code evaluation via Code.eval_string (elixir) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the Code.eval_string call in elixir code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any Code.eval_string call matches, including trusted uses such as local tooling. Whether the evaluated string is attacker-controlled needs human review.
fpNotes: Build scripts, REPL helpers, and test harnesses evaluating trusted strings are the common false positives.
